notes: Access: robots.txt at theartment.com (site redirects www -> apex canonical host) has no Claude/agent disallow; general crawl allowed for storefront JSON. Used Tier 1 (direct HTTP curl + Shopify collections.json/products.json) successfully, no JS rendering needed. Enumerated all 270 collections via /collections.json (2 pages). Verified true catalog size independently via /collections/all/products.json pagination = 765 unique products (collections.json's own 'all'=1490 and 'all-products'=487 figures are both inflated/inconsistent per the known Shopify products_count unreliability). Screened every collection title/handle for Diwali, Christmas/Pre-Christmas, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Valentine's Day, Mother's/Father's Day, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Eid. Found candidate holiday-named collections: diwali-gifting(+x-artifacts/x-barware), diwali-offer-flat-{10,15,20,25}-off, products-on-offer ('DIWALI - GRAB OR GONE OFFERS', 680 items), artifacts/barware/lighting-diwali24, rakhi-special(+shop-for-brother/sister), pre-christmas-x-{artifacts,barware,wall-art}, valentines-day-sale(+5 product-type variants), and holi-sale-x-barware. Sampled actual product lists (title+tags) for every one of these via /collections/<handle>/products.json rather than trusting the title or the (inflated) products_count. RESULT: only the 'Diwali Gifting' family is genuine. Its products are 100% titled '<Name> Gift Box' and tagged exactly 'diwaligift' (e.g. 'Diamond Tumbler Glasses Gift Box', 'Feng Shui Bonsai Brilliance Gift Box') -- a small (11 unique products out of 765, 1.4% of catalog), occasion-specific, deliberately curated Diwali gifting range. collections.json reported inflated counts for this family (21/14/17) vs the real fetched counts (5/6/5, union of unique IDs across the three = 11) -- used the verified union figure. Everything else tested FAILED the content-verification test and was excluded as a generic-catalog-relabeled-as-holiday false positive: (1) diwali-offer-flat-X-off and products-on-offer are large clearance/sale slices (products-on-offer alone = 680 items, 89% of catalog) full of unrelated goods (shoe racks, floor mirrors, cutlery) tagged with generic sale tags (BOGO1, clearance2026, FDAUG, slowmoving) -- these are discount tiers, not occasion products. (2) artifacts/barware/lighting-diwali24 all key off a stale 'diwali24' tag that also appears verbatim inside rakhi-special, pre-christmas-x-barware, and valentines-day-sale samples -- proof the tag is a leftover generic 2024-sale-campaign marker reused across unrelated 'holiday' collections, not a genuine Diwali signal. (3) rakhi-special (250+ sampled, collections.json claims 269) and its brother/sister splits (117/213) contain wall clocks, bath mats, mirrors, resin animal figurines, teacups -- no rakhi/bracelet-related products at all; this is a generic large gifting slice (>30% of catalog) reused under a Rakhi label. (4) pre-christmas-x-{artifacts,barware,wall-art} contain generic figurines, whiskey glasses, and canvas prints with no Christmas iconography (no trees/ornaments/Santa) and share the same 'diwali24' tag noted above. (5) valentines-day-sale (250+ sampled, collections.json claims 496 = 65% of catalog) includes furniture (stools, chairs), bath mats, and shoe cabinets -- entirely generic. (6) holi-sale-x-barware's own Shopify title field is literally 'Summer Sale X Barware' (handle says holi, title says summer) with generic barware contents and no Holi color/pichkari theming -- a mislabeled/reused summer-sale collection, not Holi. No standalone New Year, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Eid, Mother's Day, or Father's Day collections exist anywhere in the 270-collection taxonomy. Net result: exactly one genuine seasonal category found (Diwali gift boxes).

rows.evidence: Union of unique products across /collections/diwali-gifting, /collections/diwali-gifting-x-artifacts and /collections/diwali-gifting-x-barware (fetched via products.json) = 11 unique items, all titled '<Product Name> Gift Box' (e.g. Diamond Tumbler Glasses Gift Box, Feng Shui Bonsai Brilliance Gift Box, Renaissance Dual Delight Glasses Gift Box, Golden-Horned Rhino Table Accent Gift Box) and all carrying the single tag 'diwaligift'. Only 1.4% of the site's 765-product catalog, confirming a genuinely curated occasion range rather than a relabeled generic collection. Note collections.json's own products_count field for these handles (21/14/17) is inflated versus the actual products.json fetch (5/6/5, union 11) -- qty here uses the verified union.
